preconditions.description: The number of queries is between 1 and 500,000, inclusive.
Each query is either of type 1 or type 2.
The parent of a new vertex or the root of a subtree for a query of type 2 is a valid vertex index.
The number of vertices is always less than the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(output[i] - expected_output[i]) <= 1e-6 for i in range(len(output)))
postconditions.description: The output has an absolute or relative error of at most 10^-6 with respect to the expected output for each query of the second type.
